item.title: Ergodox EZ
item.author: cancheta.dev@gmail.com (Charles Ancheta)
item.description: In 2022, I received an Ergodox EZ as a Christmas gift. It felt pretty nice at first, but I had the idea to also learn Dvorak with it, which made me abandon it for a few months.
